Graduate Admissions
Come Build with Us
The Fariborz Maseeh Department of Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering is developing engineers who create and test sustainable infrastructure in this increasingly urban world.
Deadlines for Texas CAEE graduate school applications
Fall/Summer due December 1; Spring due September 1
Minimum Requirements: GPA 3.0, English exam for international applicants
A comprehensive list of all other graduate program admissions deadlines is offered by the Cockrell School of Engineering.
What is the application process?
Application for admission to the Graduate School is a multi-step process. The application process may take several weeks to complete; applications should be submitted well in advance of the deadline to ensure adequate time to submit all required items. Please review all required admissions materials and prepare your application materials in advance to avoid missing the application submittal window.
We recommend monitoring MyStatus for required application materials and updates during the application process after it is submitted. Please note that applications can take up to 72 hours to load to the University of Texas at Austin system after the application form is submitted.
Application fee – The fee is $65 for U.S. and permanent residents and $90 for international students.
start your application
Before you start your application:
Applicants must submit all of the following materials by the appropriate deadline.
Please note:
Once you submit your documents online, they cannot be deleted or edited. Therefore, please be sure your documents are correct before you upload them.
The GRE is not required for admission or funding consideration.
Applicants must select a specific area of research when filling out the application.
Application Materials (gather in advance):
English exam for international applicants – International students applying to The University of Texas at Austin must submit either an official Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), International English Language Testing System (IELTS) or Duolingo English Test (DET) score report demonstrating an adequate knowledge of English. The Institutional TOEFL (ITP) and the IELTS General Training are not accepted. Additional information and countries qualifying for an exam waiver is available on the Graduate School website.
Official transcripts – Applicants should upload one copy of the official academic transcript from every senior college they have attended. Transcripts are not required from junior colleges and community colleges. See instructions for uploading the pdf of transcript(s).
Statement of Purpose (SOP) – Submit online with your application. If you do not wish to be considered for financial aid or have your own funding or fellowship, please indicate so in your Statement of Purpose.
Resume – Suggested, but not required. You may upload your resume to the Cockrell graduate application.
Three letters of recommendation, preferably from academic sources – When you complete the “References” portion of the online application for admission, you will list the names and email addresses of those you have asked to recommend you. Be sure that the email addresses are current and accurate. You will be asked to inform us if you are going to waive the right to view your letters after they are submitted. Please indicate this waiver by answering the question associated with the application for admission. After you submit the application online, GIAC will send an email message to the addresses you provided and ask your recommenders to visit a website where they can complete a questionnaire and upload their letter of recommendation. Your recommenders will be informed if you have not waived your right to view their letters of recommendation.
To monitor and maintain your requests for reference, please go to MyStatus. There, you can monitor the status of your pending recommendations, resend a Request for Reference email to your recommenders, add a new recommender, and revise your FERPA (right to view) status from retained to waived. If you have additional questions about online recommendation letters, email gradref@austin.utexas.edu. Online submission of recommendations is strongly preferred, but we will accept paper recommendations if absolutely necessary.
